title: KKL type and Rademacher type 2 of normed spaces are equivalent with universal comparison constants
author: Paata Ivanisvili and Yonathan Stone
source_version: Discrete Analysis 2024:2, 14 pp.; DOI 10.19086/da.117131; publisher-linked arXiv:2204.05195v3 (29 April 2024), published 3 May 2024
difficulty_reason: The new argument preserves the influence-ratio logarithmic gain through a singular vector-valued heat-semigroup integral. It explicitly symmetrizes centered noise to apply Rademacher type 2, passes through hypercontractivity and Holder interpolation, and evaluates the remaining integral by a Gaussian substitution. The short linear-function argument closes the same equivalence outcome. Conservative H1 is proposed; historical H2 is not relied on.
work: The KKL inequality and Rademacher type 2
